description:
Find catalog tracks by criteria, with no seed track: tempo, key, genre, release year,
    chart placement and audio-feature ranges in one call — e.g. house at 122-126 BPM in 8A or
    its neighbours with energy above 0.7: min={"tempo": 122, "energy": 0.7},
    max={"tempo": 126}, key="8A", harmonic=true, genre="house".

    At least one narrowing filter is required (a tempo/feature bound, key, mode, genre, year
    or chart). Returns `results` (one per recording, each with its bpm, camelot, energy,
    danceability, valence, acousticness and loudness_db plus catalog metadata),
    `total_matches` (exact up to 1,000; `total_matches_capped` above that), `next_offset`
    for the next page, and `filters` — what was applied and how many tracks each filter
    removed (`dropped_by`); if the list is short, loosen the largest one. energy, danceability
    and valence are on FreqBlog's own scales, so derive thresholds from values you have seen
    rather than from another service's. Results reach a depth of 500 per query; narrow the
    filters to go further. Pass a result's itunes_track_id to get_audio_features for every
    field, or to suggest_next_track / build_setlist. Costs 1 quota unit.

charted.description: true = only tracks with a known chart placement (about 4% of tracks have one).
charted.title: Charted

explicit.description: true = explicit tracks only, false = non-explicit only; omit for either.
explicit.title: Explicit

genre.description: Comma list of catalog genre names, e.g. 'house' or 'hip-hop,r&b'. Unknown names in a list are skipped and listed in filters.ignored with close matches; only a list where every name is unknown is rejected.
genre.title: Genre

harmonic.description: Widen each key to its harmonically compatible keys (same, relative, one step either way on the Camelot wheel).
harmonic.title: Harmonic

include_subgenres.description: Also match every subgenre of a top-level genre.
include_subgenres.title: Include Subgenres

key.description: Comma list of keys: Camelot ('8A'), Open Key ('1m') or names ('A minor').
key.title: Key

max.description: HARD upper bounds, e.g. {'tempo': 126}. Same attributes as `min`; combine the two for a range.
max.title: Max

min.description: HARD lower bounds, e.g. {'tempo': 122, 'energy': 0.7}. Tracks below the bound, and tracks with no analysed value, are excluded. Attributes: acousticness, danceability, duration_ms, energy, loudness, tempo, valence.
min.title: Min

min_chart_peak.description: Best chart position required, as chart_peak (1-100, 100 = a number one).
min_chart_peak.title: Min Chart Peak

offset.description: Skip this many tracks for the next page; offset + limit may not exceed 500.
offset.title: Offset

sort.description: 'chart' (default: charted first, then newest), 'newest', 'oldest', 'tempo', '-tempo', 'energy', '-energy', or 'target' (default when `target` is given).
sort.title: Sort

target.description: PREFERRED values, e.g. {'energy': 0.8}: nearest first, nothing removed. Same attributes as `min`.
target.title: Target

tempo_match.description: 'exact' (default) or 'half_double' — also match double/half the min/max tempo range (an 87 BPM track for a 174 BPM set).
tempo_match.title: Tempo Match

name: discover_tracks
title: Discover Tracks by Criteria
